test_std_exception: test that pybind11 throws a standard C++ exception and translates it to a Python RuntimeError
test_cross_module_exceptions: test that exceptions thrown across pybind11 modules are correctly translated to Python exception types
test_custom: test custom pybind11 exception types including subclassing and fallback to standard handlers
test_nested_throws: test nested C++ to Python to C++ exception handling and translation chains
test_flaky_exception_failure_point_init: test pybind11 error_already_set handling when a flaky exception fails during initialization
